items.title: Perez faces a five-place grid drop
items.summary: Las Vegas Stewards' Document 61 converts Perez's unserved collision time penalty into a five-place drop at the next race in which he participates. Qatar is the expected next race.
items.why_it_matters: Include the carry-over in grid preparation. Do not copy Vegas power-unit penalties or energy limits into Qatar's own event data.
